human_review_guidance: You are deciding whether the comparison summary faithfully describes recorded evidence, not whether either suburb is safe, unsafe, good or bad. Approve only when every critical and high check passed and the prose names the shared period and measure, source coverage, limitations, missing observations and any rate-denominator limitation. Reject causal claims, predictions and safety rankings. Where evidence_mode is seeded_demonstration, the summary must say so. Use "correct" to send the Worker and Reviewer back once with a note, "partial" to accept only the evidence steps that hold, and "reject" when the review should not be used.
objective: Review one saved suburb comparison against its published crime evidence and explain whether its period, measure, sources, coverage, missing observations and any rate denominator support the comparison. Preserve recorded zero separately from missing evidence. Do not rank suburb safety, infer causes or predict crime.
planner_guidance: Inspect the saved comparison first for its localities, period, measure, indicators and notes. Then read the published crime evidence resolved for that exact comparison. Plan only these two read-only steps. Never plan a write, a safety ranking, a causal claim or a prediction.

reviewer_checks.description: The saved comparison contains at least two localities.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Save at least two supported localities before reviewing the comparison.

reviewer_checks.description: Every series uses the saved comparison period.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Do not compare series from inconsistent periods; correct the evidence projection.

reviewer_checks.description: Every series uses the same count or rate measure.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Do not compare mixed measures; correct the evidence projection.

reviewer_checks.description: Missing observations remain distinct from recorded zeroes.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Correct the projection so unavailable observations are never treated as zero.

reviewer_checks.description: A rate comparison has a valid population denominator for every locality.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Use counts or provide valid denominators; do not present an unsupported rate.

reviewer_checks.description: The comparison has at least partial published evidence coverage.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Load published crime evidence before accepting the comparison review.

reviewer_checks.description: At least one source release is recorded for the evidence.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Do not use unattributed crime figures; publish an attributable source release first.

reviewer_checks.description: The evidence reports the limitations that bound the comparison.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: Carry the evidence limitations into the review before accepting it.

reviewer_checks.description: The evidence states its responsible-use constraint.
reviewer_checks.recommendation: State that recorded crime evidence is not a suburb safety ranking.
